notes: First full Montessori curriculum drop. 208-page sample of a commercial product (Hometessori by MindSprout). Key insight: Montessori homeschool requires print-and-make alternatives to expensive classroom materials. The curriculum includes both teacher manuals (lesson presentations) and print kits (materials). This is a significant methodology addition for Homa.
